text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On my way home, I spot Symboli<n>Rudolf heading
for the practice track.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
With things unusually quiet around<n>the academy, I
could think of no better<n>way to spend my free
time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, but there's no need to worry.<n>I find the
exertion pleasantly bracing.
choice_data_list: Don't bite off more than you can chew.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha, I knew you would see things<n>my way!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then we shall train for as long as<n>time allows.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Together we'll strive for heights that<n>none have
ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Sure enough, the two of us end up<n>training until the
track closes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
All Umamusume have a responsibility<n>to take their
trainer's words<n>seriously.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Very well. I will consider training<n>finished for today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't do to fix my sights so high<n>that I fall
flat on my face.
